title: RDX Approvers v1
description: Canonical schema for _bmad/rdx/approvers.yaml — the in-repo source of truth for Cat-4 specialist approval routing (A3 hybrid). Maps rule-pattern → role → list of allowed identities (git author emails OR GitHub @teams/@users). The validator consumes this file directly; `rdx-setup sync-codeowners` projects it into .github/CODEOWNERS for GitHub UX.

roles.description: Map of role name (e.g. unsafe-reviewers, crypto-reviewers, governance) to its identity list.

items.description: Either an email address (`user@example.com`) or an @-prefixed GitHub handle / team (`@user`, `@org/team`).

patterns.description: Path-pattern → role mapping. `path` is a glob (fnmatch with `**` recursion). `rule_id` is the synthetic Cat-4 rule the validator emits when the pattern matches. `role` must exist in the `roles` map.
